title: paspalum laeve var. australe
intro: Paspalum laeve var. australe, commonly known as Paspalum, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum include wound healing, anti-allergic, and anti-diabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. These constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects and potential health benefits.
